title: Washing the Dishes
context: After dinner: the sink, the sponge, drying, putting everything away. Tiny everyday actions — surprisingly hard to narrate in English the first time.
contextPersian: بعد از شام: سینک، اسکاج، خشک کردن، سر جا گذاشتن. کارهای کوچک روزمره که بار اول گفتنشان به انگلیسی سخت‌تر از چیزی است که فکر می‌کنی.

expressions.example: You cooked, so I'll do the dishes.
expressions.examplePersian: تو آشپزی کردی، پس من ظرف‌ها را می‌شویم.
expressions.note: Also 'wash up' (BrE). 'Wash the dishes' is fine too; 'do the dishes' is most common.

expressions.example: Rinse the plates before putting them in the rack.
expressions.examplePersian: بشقاب‌ها را قبل از گذاشتن در جاظرفی آب بکش.

expressions.example: This pan needs a good scrub — the rice stuck to it.
expressions.examplePersian: این قابلمه حسابی سابیدن می‌خواهد — برنج تهش چسبیده.

expressions.example: We're almost out of washing-up liquid.
The sink is full of dishes again!
expressions.examplePersian: سینک دوباره پر از ظرف است!

expressions.example: I'll wash and you dry the dishes.
expressions.examplePersian: من می‌شویم، تو ظرف‌ها را خشک کن.

expressions.example: Can you put the dishes away once they're dry?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود وقتی خشک شدند ظرف‌ها را سر جایشان بگذاری؟

expressions.example: Just load the dishwasher and I'll run it tonight.
expressions.examplePersian: فقط ماشین را پر کن، من شب روشنش می‌کنم.

expressions.example: Leave the pot to soak overnight.
expressions.examplePersian: بگذار قابلمه یک شب خیس بخورد.

exercises.explanation: Wash and dry — شستن و خشک کردن.
exercises.explanationPersian: تقسیم کار: I'll wash and you dry.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe how you clean up after dinner, step by step.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: مرحله به مرحله بگو بعد از شام چطور جمع‌وجور می‌کنی.
modelSentences: After dinner I do the dishes.
I rinse the plates and scrub the pans.
I leave the big pot to soak.
Then I dry everything and put the dishes away.

roleplay.aiRole: The learner's family member negotiating after-dinner cleanup
roleplay.learnerRole: You're organizing who washes, who dries, who puts away
roleplay.objective: Divide the cleanup naturally, including one objection
roleplay.context: The sink is full after a big dinner. Decide together who does what; the other person tries to get the easier job.
roleplay.opening: Wow, look at that sink. So... wash or dry — which one do you want?
